name: ozon_search_camoufox
description: Ozon.ru search results page (Russia). Returns one flat array per field across result cards; consumers zip them by index. ROW-ALIGNMENT INVARIANT: each field matches exactly one node per card, so every optional value is dug out of the per-card container's html by regex and a card without it yields null in its slot instead of shrinking the column and shifting every row after it. Ozon's class names are build hashes (g3p_21, ag5_12_6-a0 ...) that rotate between releases, so every selector anchors on what survives a release: the `data-widget="tileGridDesktop"` grid, the `tile-root` card class, the `tile-clickable-element` anchor class and the typography classes (tsBody500Medium = title, tsHeadline500Medium = current price, tsBodyControl300XSmall = rating and review count); self_heal is on for the day one of those moves. `urls` reads the anchor that wraps the TITLE (each card carries two anchors to the same product, one around the image), drops Ozon's `?at=` attribution token and resolves absolute. Prices carry U+2009 thin spaces as thousands separators ("55 119 ₽"); parse_price reads them as grouping since 2026-09-06 (they used to parse as 55.0). Ozon may answer a generic query with a category page ("category_was_predicted") instead of /search/; the tile grid is the same widget on both. At `load` the grid holds the first server-rendered batch (8 tiles measured; 24 on a run that settled longer) -- Ozon appends the rest on scroll, which a preset does not do. The antibot challenge ("Antibot Challenge Page", HTTP 403, JS proof + reload) is passed by the homepage warmup: without it both engines got the challenge page on every probe (2026-09-06). ENGINE: Camoufox, fingerprint_profile=windows_on_host. MEASURED 2026-09-06 through the preset as shipped (research/preset_audit_new_bases_2026_09_06.json): 2 of 2 runs returned the grid, 8 rows each, every column full, urls absolute, retries 0, took_ms 24-28 s; the probes earlier that day: 2 of 2 with the homepage warmup (706 KB and 863 KB pages). timeout_ms 31000 (per-phase, with the 10 s warmup dwell; see test_builtin_timeout_fits_the_first_attempt). ROW-ALIGNMENT FIX (review 2026-09-08): `titles` and `urls` require the title span, but `prices`/`ratings`/`review_counts` selected every `.tile-root`. A card rendered without a title (Ozon does this for some promo tiles) shortened the first two columns while the last three kept their slot, so every later row paired with the previous card's price -- reproduced: titles 2, prices 3, and the third title zipped against the second card's price. All five columns now select from the same card set: a tile that carries a title.
